title: Coach Yogesh Vats WhatsApp Sales Bot Fine-Tune Dataset
description: Schema for train.jsonl and valid.jsonl used to fine-tune the Coach Yogesh Vats WhatsApp sales bot.

prompt.description: Full input string: the exact system prompt followed by a blank line and then the user's incoming WhatsApp message. Format: '<SYSTEM_PROMPT>\n\n<USER_MESSAGE>'
prompt.example:
You are Coach Yogesh Vats messaging from your personal WhatsApp...

Hi, who is this?

completion.description: Yogesh Vats' ideal reply — short, WhatsApp-friendly, warm, casual friend tone. For negative examples, this intentionally demonstrates bad behavior (long paragraphs, aggression, fabricated claims).
completion.example: Yogesh Vats here 😊 I coach teams on Jira and Agile. Quick question — do you work with Jira?

meta.description: Metadata about the training example for filtering, analysis, and curriculum balance.

scenario.description: The conversation scenario type this example belongs to.

name_present.description: Whether the contact's name is present/known in this example. Yogesh should use it if true.

role_relevant.description: Whether the contact's role is relevant to the Jira + AI Masterclass (i.e., they work in tech, PM, or Agile).

tone.description: The intended tone of the assistant's completion.

label.description: Whether this is a positive (ideal) example or a negative (bad behavior) example. Negative examples teach the model what NOT to do.
